name: GDPR
description: EU General Data Protection Regulation overlay. Activated by personal data, health data, children's data, or biometric data declarations.

PR-05.regulatory_citation: GDPR Art. 30 - Records of processing activities

DE-01.regulatory_citation: GDPR Art. 33 - Notification of personal data breach

notes: GDPR requires data protection by design and by default (Art. 25), security of processing (Art. 32), and records of processing activities (Art. 30). This overlay adds data protection evidence fields and tightens controls handling personal data.
